CREATE TABLE YEARMONTH (
	CUSTOMERID INTEGER,
	DATE VARCHAR(20),
	CONSUMPTION INTEGER
);

-- ----------sql1------------
-- 5
-- 3
SELECT YEARMONTH.CUSTOMERID FROM YEARMONTH INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(CONSUMPTION) AS MAX_CONSUMPTION FROM YEARMONTH WHERE DATE = '201309') AS MAX_VALUES ON YEARMONTH.CONSUMPTION = MAX_VALUES.MAX_CONSUMPTION AND YEARMONTH.DATE = '201309';
-- ----------sql2------------
-- 5
SELECT T1.CUSTOMERID FROM CUSTOMERS AS T1 INNER JOIN YEARMONTH AS T2 ON T1.CUSTOMERID = T2.CUSTOMERID WHERE T2.DATE = '201309' GROUP BY T1.CUSTOMERID ORDER BY SUM(T2.CONSUMPTION) DESC LIMIT 1;
